title: world's best ai vs geoguessr pro
summary: GeoGuessr pro Rainbolt plays head-to-head against an AI built by Stanford students that guesses locations from street-view images. The video shows the AI repeatedly beating him.
why: Cited as an early, concrete example of AI outperforming top GeoGuessr players, in threads on AI photo geolocation.

quote.text: The best player in the world, Rainbolt, played against an AI out of Stanford
